name: async_discard
source: import {Context} from 'vibelang/context'; import {Layer} from 'vibelang/provider'; abstract class C extends Context{abstract n():number} const seen:number[]=[]; function read():number{seen.push(C.context().n());return 9} async function f():Promise<number>{read();return seen.length} export async function main():Promise<number>{return await Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C,{n:()=>7}),async()=>await f())}

name: method_discard
source: import {Context} from 'vibelang/context'; import {Layer} from 'vibelang/provider'; abstract class C extends Context{abstract n():number} const seen:number[]=[]; function read():number{seen.push(C.context().n());return 9} class Box{ f():number{read();return seen.length} } export function main():number{return Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C,{n:()=>7}),()=>new Box().f())}

name: callback_discard
source: import {Context} from 'vibelang/context'; import {Layer} from 'vibelang/provider'; abstract class C extends Context{abstract n():number} const seen:number[]=[]; function read():number{seen.push(C.context().n());return 9} export function main():number{return Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C,{n:()=>7}),()=>{[1].forEach(()=>{read()});return seen.length})}

name: row_assign

name: result_branch

name: result_uninvoked
source: class E extends Error{} function read():Result<number,E>{throw new E('lost')} export function main():string[]{const r=read();const ignored=()=>r.isError();return ['ok']}

name: result_collection
source: class E extends Error{} function read():Result<number,E>{throw new E('lost')} function pack():Result<number,E>[] {return [read(),read()]} export function main():string[]{const rs=pack();rs[0]?.isError();return ['ok']}

name: promise_branch
source: async function work():Promise<number>{return 7} async function f(flag:boolean):Promise<number>{const p=work();if(flag)await p;return 3} export async function main():Promise<string[]>{return [String(await f(false))]}

name: promise_result_abort
source: class E extends Error{} function read():Result<number,E>{throw new E('lost')} async function work():Promise<number>{return 7} async function f():Promise<Result<number,E>>{const p=work();const r=read()!;await p;return r} export async function main():Promise<string[]>{return [String((await f()).unwrapOr(-1))]}

name: finally_return
source: class E extends Error{} function fail():Result<number,E> {throw new E('x')} function f():Result<number,E> { try {return fail()!} finally {return 7} } export function main():number{return f().unwrapOr(-1)}

name: finally_throw
source: class E extends Error{} function fail():Result<number,E>{throw new E('first')} function f():Result<number,E>{try{return fail()!}finally{throw new E('second')}} export function main():string{return f().match({ok:()=>'',error:e=>e.message})}

name: async_finally_throw
source: class E extends Error{} async function fail():Promise<Result<number,E>>{throw new E('first')} async function f():Promise<Result<number,E>>{try{return (await fail())!}finally{throw new E('second')}} export async function main():Promise<string>{const r=await f();return r.match({ok:()=>'',error:e=>e.message})}

name: error_extract
source: class E extends Error{} function fail():Result<number,E>{throw new E('extracted')} function errorOf(r:Result<number,E>):E|undefined{return r.match({ok:()=>undefined,error:e=>e})} export function main():string[]{const error=fail().match({ok:()=>undefined,error:e=>e});return [error?.message??'none']}

name: result_oob
source: class E extends Error{} function f(rs:Result<number,E>[]):Result<number,E>{return rs[0]!} export function main():string[]{return [String(f([]).unwrapOr(-1))]}
